div.div:
Reading the gateway arrow, and what is not drawn
The gateway's one arrow is ten allows: it reaches :8080 in every fenced namespace (identity for the id route and remoteJWKS; inventory's pods only), and also :9090 in review, notification and shipping, whose allow names no port. All ten service namespaces reach identity :8080 for the JWKS, since their pkg/authmw verifier is fail-closed; monitoring reaches identity :9000 / :8080 (the data-tier diagram); payment admits its own namespace on :8080 for mockpay. Allows into inventory and product's :9090 select only the service pods (pod-scoped).

switch.text: Reading the gateway arrow, and what is not drawn...

div.div:
The arrow that does not exist
Nothing may call checkout on :9090: it is a gRPC client of the mesh, never a server to it. Only the gateway reaches checkout, on :8080.
